description:
Most corporate event photos never get used. Not because they are bad. Because no one planned where they would go.

300 to 500 images arrive in a shared folder. The events team is already running the next project. No one has been assigned to distribute the content. Two weeks later, the press window has closed and the images are sitting unlabeled.

The fix is not a better photographer. It is a distribution plan built before the shoot brief is written.

If you are planning an upcoming event and want documentation your team will actually use, visit whitepaper.site.

What is the biggest bottleneck in your post-event content workflow?
